name: FAQ
description: Database-managed FAQ with categories, publish toggles and drag-free reordering, rendered by the Puck block "Faq" as an accordion. Unlike the core static Accordion block, it emits Google FAQPage structured data (JSON-LD) so your questions qualify for rich results in search.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Read the FAQ entries and their categories.
Create the plugin's FAQ table and insert/update/reorder/delete entries.
Expose the admin CRUD endpoints and the public FAQ list the Puck block consumes.
Add the FAQ entry to the admin sidebar.
